avis.texte: My skin feels really clean and it has a glow to it after using this product.

I been using Proactiv since it came out. I really didn't have bad acne. I use Proactiv as a skin maintenance. Keeps my skin looking and feeling good. Most people, think I am younger than 61 years old. So, in my opinion, it's keeps me looking young also. Many of my coworkers and friends use Proactiv, because they wanted to know what I use to keep my skin looking good. I also get Proactiv , at the price I started with. So, it's affordable skin care at a great price.

Gifted by proactiv in exchange for my honest review. This mask is easy to use and my skin looks brighter, smoother, and more even after 2 uses. My before/after pic is after using the product 3 days apart to give my skin a break in between. The tool included makes it easy to get a thin, even layer of product.

avis.titre: Perfect for dark spot reducing & even tone!
avis.texte: I feel like before using this mask I was sleeping on it but I kid you not, after using it for less than a week I could already see a clear difference in my skin, hyperpigmentation and dark spots. The ingredients which include Tranexamic Acid & Gluconolactone to help resurface, Turmeric root extract to help reduce the appearance of redness, and vitamin C to help brighten skin. And as you can see in the pictures my skin is brighter, clearer and more even toned. I am so impressed and highly recommend! Gifted by Proactiv

I love a good mask and this one passes the test! I have been having some issues with clogged pores and some dark spots from acne. This product helps exfoliate and clean my pores while also leaving my skin brighter! Love the texture of the mask and the little applicator. Easy to use and I actually look forward to using it a couple times a week! Complimentary from proactiv.

This is one of those products that doesn't feel super strong while it's on, but after using it a few times, I noticed my skin looked smoother and more even. The redness I experience on my cheeks has seemingly calmed which I am particularly grateful for. The texture is creamy and easy to apply, and the applicator it comes with actually makes a difference because it keeps things clean and helps spread the mask evenly. It doesn't feel greasy, it rinses off easily, and it didn't irritate my mildly sensitive skin, which is a huge plus. I've been using it a couple times a week at night, and I always make sure to wear sunscreen the next day since it can make your skin more sensitive to the sun. It's simple, no fuss, and it's actually doing what it says it will. I received this complimentary from proactiv.

Received this order complimentary from Proactiv. Was excited to try this brand in my skincare route. I apply this product 2 times a day at morning and night. I use on my face and let it set 10 minutes as directed and wipe off with a damp cloth. Afterwards my skin feels very soothing and hydrated! I really don't have any dark spots on my skin so couldn't see if that helped. Would recommend!

I was very excited and had high hopes for the Proactiv Smooth & Bright Resurfacing Mask because I usually like Proactiv products. I wasn't impressed with this one. I love the applicator brush that it comes with. It feels like a luxurious treatment. I personally didn't find that it was very brightening or resurfacing. I received this product complimentary from the brand.

I'm obsessed with this mask from proactiv! The best part is it comes with an applicator brush. I have been using this to try to reduce my dark spots and marks. I have definitely seen a difference in how bright my skin looks. I love the ingredients - especially the vitamin c and turmeric root extract. Highly recommend! Gifted by proactiv.

I was gifted the Proactiv Smooth and Bright Resurfacing Mask complimentary from Proactiv to sample. I have been using this consistently and have noticed my skin clearing up. Very easy to apply with applicator and rinse off. Definitely recommend

Complimentary from proactiv I used this mask for a week and I can really tell a difference in my skin. It looks so much more glowy and my some of my acne scars began to fade away. I worried this was going to make me break out bc I have sensitive skin but it didn't and I highly recommend.

I absolutely love the texture of this bright resurfacing mask! It is silky and contains good-for-you ingredients like Vitamin C! It deeply hydrates my skin with a radiant finish. This topical mask works quickly and effectively to improve skin clarity. Complimentary from Proactiv.

I love that this mask helps with lighting dark spots and reduce acne. The mask left my face feeling clean and smooth. The mask does not have a scent. The applicator is a nice addition so you can use it to apply evenly in your skin. The mask is thin and doesn't cause your skin to be irritated when using. The mask is helpful for me to use twice a week to keep acne away. The mask did not dry my skin out. Gifted by proactive

I love this product! I can see some serious resurfacing on my skin. Thank you.

Love the feel! First time using this product and I'm obsessed like the rest of the proactive line. I have used this brand for at least 15 years. 40 years old now and love seeing them cater to us as we getting older, too!

I recently tried Proactiv's Smooth & Bright Resurfacing Mask, and I'm impressed! The mask has a gentle warming sensation, making it feel like a mini spa treatment. Its gooey texture spreads smoothly and is easy to remove, unlike some exfoliating masks that can be harsh. One of the things I love most is the thoughtful ingredient list. It includes Turmeric Root Extract to help reduce inflammation and calm the skin, making it perfect for soothing irritation. Vitamin C is also in the mix, which is great for brightening and evening skin tone, giving a radiant glow. Gluconolactone provides mild exfoliation while being gentle enough for sensitive skin, and Tranexamic Acid works to minimize dark spots and discoloration, helping to improve overall skin clarity. After just one use, my skin felt softer, more supple, and had a noticeable glow. This mask is a promising addition to my skincare routine, and I'm excited to see the results with continued use!
I love this mask! It's like honey and I rub it into my face, leave for 10 minutes, and my face feels so fresh. Brighter visibly.
